identity.name: Hydra
identity.description: Codename: Lernaean Strain. A potent synthetic coagulant mixed with experimental stem-cell accelerators. Designed to keep combatants in the fight during prolonged engagements, HDR-A kickstarts the body's natural healing systems into overdrive. Much like the mythical serpent that grew two heads for every one severed, this stimulant ensures that as fast as the operator's flesh is torn open, the body immediately begins stitching it back together for the duration of the drug's long half-life.
